decisions.reason: After another year on the market, the hand-knotted wool-silk carpet carries more sunk cost and reputational commitment while still fitting the firm's craftsmanship and premium-material identity, so management would be inclined to continue it.

The corner bench remains close to the core furniture business and usable across residential and project settings, making it easy for management to justify further support rather than admit a failed launch.
The swivel shell chair is a multi-model line tied to flexible workplace concepts and broader public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
